img#tab-card-icon starts hidden with no src by design; renderTabCard() in panel.js sets its src once a real tab favicon URL is known. Not an unfilled placeholder.

One remaining 11px leaf text, verified by rendering the built panel.html: #tab-card-title (the tab-preview card's title, e.g. 'no tab yet'). It is a status/caption readout, not body content the user reads at length and not an action hint — the textbook defensible case per the design's own type scale (--text-2xs: 11px reserved for captions/status, matching the Codex reference's --text-xs: 11px). The standalone #status-text run-status strip this note previously also covered no longer exists: the panel-match-comp pass adopted the comp's composer/topbar composition, folding the live readout into the trace header (#steps-label) instead of a strip bolted underneath the composer.
